name: Riding Club
body:
A long wooden handled mallet with a stone hammer head. It is designed to be long enough to be used from horseback. These weapons are often decorated with vibrant colors. A riding club deals double damage when used from the back of a charging mount. While mounted, you can wield a riding club with one hand.
